pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anācāraṃ ācaritvā aññāṇakena āpannāti jānantūti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.3: “idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vakkhanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.6: ‘idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.7: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadetha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.8: idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vakkhatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.12: “idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.15.1: “yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.16: idāneva kho ahaṃ jānāmi ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.17: tañce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvattikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne ko pana vādo bhiyyo na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi yañca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno tañca yathādhammo kāretabbo uttariṃ cassa moho āropetabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.18: tassa te āvuso alābhā tassa te dulladdhaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikarosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.11: aññāṇakena āpannoti jānantūti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.12: idāneva kho ahaṃ jānāmi ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī”ti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.13: tañceti: mohetukāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvattikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne ko pana vādo bhīyo. na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi. yañca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno tañca yathādhammo kāretabbo. uttariṃ cassa moho āropetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.17: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi karoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.18: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno mohaṃ āropeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.21: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasikaroti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.23: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno mohassa āropanā so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.26: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
